products.description: The UR9 uses RGB MiniLED powered by Hisense Chromagic technology, generating red, green and blue light individually for True 100% BT.2020 coverage with Pantone Validated colour. It adds the Hi-View AI Engine RGB, an ultra-low reflection panel, a native 180Hz refresh rate and a 4.1.2 multi-channel sound system tuned by Devialet.
products.keywords: hisense ur9 rgb miniled tv 4k google tv

specs.audio: 4.1.2 multi-channel, tuned by Devialet, Dolby Atmos

products.name: Hisense U7 Series MiniLED ULED 4K Google TV (2026)
products.summary: 2026 MiniLED ULED 4K TV with a native 165Hz refresh rate, full-array local dimming and 2.1.2 Dolby Atmos audio, up to 116 inches.
products.description: The 2026 U7 Series (U7SG with Google TV) uses Hi-QLED MiniLED Pro with full-array local dimming, the Hi-View AI Engine Pro and a native 165Hz refresh rate. It includes 50W 2.1.2 multi-channel audio with Dolby Atmos and DTS Virtual:X, in sizes up to 116 inches.
products.keywords: hisense u7 u7sg miniled uled tv 165hz google tv

specs.panelDetails: Hi-QLED MiniLED Pro, full-array local dimming

products.name: 8BitDo Ultimate 2 Bluetooth Controller
products.summary: Switch and Windows controller with TMR sticks, switchable Hall-effect triggers and a charging dock.
products.description: The Ultimate 2 Bluetooth Controller works with Switch (and Switch 2 via firmware update) and Windows over Bluetooth, 2.4G or USB. It has TMR joysticks with a 12-bit ADC, Hall Effect triggers that switch between linear and tactile modes, and a charging dock that also extends the wireless signal. It weighs 246 g.
products.keywords: 8bitdo ultimate 2 controller switch pc tmr hall effect

products.name: 8BitDo Pro 3 Bluetooth Gamepad
products.summary: Retro-styled pro gamepad for Switch, PC, SteamOS, Apple and Android with TMR sticks, dual-mode triggers and back paddles.
products.description: The 8BitDo Pro 3 connects over 2.4G, Bluetooth or USB to Switch 1/2, Windows, SteamOS, Android and Apple devices. It has TMR joysticks, triggers that switch between linear Hall Effect and tactile modes, two remappable L4/R4 back buttons, a 1000mAh battery and a charging dock.
products.keywords: 8bitdo pro 3 controller retro switch pc steam deck

products.name: 8BitDo Ultimate 3E Controller for Xbox
products.summary: Officially licensed Xbox controller with swappable ABXY, stick and D-pad modules, TMR sticks and a wireless charging dock.
products.description: The Ultimate 3E is 8BitDo's pro-level, officially licensed controller for Xbox Series X|S, Windows and mobile. It offers swappable ABXY modules (silicone or micro-switch), joysticks and D-pads, TMR joysticks with a 12-bit ADC, a contactless magnetic wireless charging dock and 1000Hz polling on PC.
products.keywords: 8bitdo ultimate 3e xbox controller modular tmr
